_: Phase 36 Theme H. The ONE budget source: read by scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs --assert and by every spec under packages/app/e2e/perf/. Rebaselining procedure is in ./README.md — do not edit a number here without the run that justifies it.
_sizes: Deterministic, so the headroom is tight (1.13x the post-phase measurement). The 2.5x rule the phase set is a FLAKE allowance and a byte count does not flake; at 2.5x the entry budget would be 2712 KB, which is above the 2481 KB this phase started from — a budget that permits undoing the phase is not a budget.
_timings: Median of 5 cold packaged-equivalent runs x 2.5, per the phase's stated rule. Medians never maxima, asserted in-spec, and the suite lives outside the default gate.
_scroll: Median frame gap over a 60-frame rAF-driven scroll of a 4000-line diff, x 2.5. Inherited as a literal 100 from diff-scroll-perf.spec.ts, which was an order-of-magnitude tripwire rather than a budget; the measurement is 8.5 ms, so the rule gives 22.
_retention: Phase 45 Theme A. UNLIKE every other budget above, this is a SLOPE (bytes retained PER CYCLE), not a ceiling on a level — the 1.15x/2.5x multiplier rule does NOT apply to it. Set from observed RSS noise on the phase author's machine across repo-cycle and browser-tabs-cycle runs (both expected flat): main/renderer swung up to ~250 KB/cycle from GC and allocator churn alone with only 10-20 samples. 500 KB/cycle sits above that noise floor while still catching Theme C's multi-MB-per-session leak over a real run. Provisional pending more history — see the phase doc's own open question about CI inclusion.
_popoutRss: Phase 84 Theme H.4. A LEVEL, not a slope — the renderer-RSS delta `memory-report.mjs --popout=graph` measures between a baseline sample (main window only, a repo already open) and a second sample once the detached Graph popout has appeared and settled. Measured against THIS repo's own checkout as the opened repo (the harness's own default), whose full git history is large enough that streaming it twice — main's own copy plus the popout's separate renderer process and QueryClient — is a real, not a synthetic, cost. Single run, not yet a median of several (unlike the timing budgets above) — 397824 KB measured, ×1.15 (the README's own rule for bytes) rounds to the value below. Provisional pending more history and a second data point on a smaller repo. Cross-checked in Phase 84 Theme J: two fresh single runs (one against the commit before Theme H, one against current main) read 291456 KB and 308256 KB respectively — both comfortably under this budget and statistically indistinguishable from each other (the delta is noise/repo-size drift between the two checkouts, not a regression or a measured Theme H win for this specific role — H's popout diet (H.1-H.3) targets bootstrap work a `graph` popout was largely skipping already, so `graph` was never the role most exposed to it).
_hiddenTerminalSessionRss: Phase 84 Theme J.1/J.3 — the owed E.6 number. A LEVEL: `memory-report.mjs --hidden-sessions=10` opens 10 real pty sessions over IPC (no renderer xterm ever mounted for them) and reads the main+broker RSS delta divided by session count. This is the main/broker floor per open-but-unrendered session — main's own bookkeeping plus node-pty/broker overhead and scrollback reservation — NOT the renderer-side saving Theme E's dispose/rehydrate actually produces (E frees a mounted xterm's WebGL/DOM canvas, which this IPC-only harness never allocates in the first place, since nothing here ever mounts a `TerminalView`). Measured identically before Theme E existed (543869af, the commit before Phase 84's first PR) and against current main: 8937.6 KB/session before, 8931.2 KB/session after — indistinguishable, exactly as expected, since this floor is orthogonal to what E changes. ×1.15 (the README's byte rule) on the after figure gives the budget below. A real number for E's renderer-side saving needs the terminal panel's own tab strip driven through Playwright (open 10 UI tabs, assert only 4 xterms mounted) rather than raw IPC — recorded in outstanding.md.
_idleSubprocessSpawns: Phase 84 Theme J.4. A ceiling on a COUNT, not bytes or a slope: `idle-cpu.mjs --blurred --assert` polls the process tree every 2s throughout the idle window (not just its start/end, so a git/gh child that starts and exits between two samples is still caught) and fails if more than this many distinct git+gh descendants of main ever appeared. Set to 0 — B/C's whole claim is that a blurred window's visibility gate stops both timers outright, not that it throttles them. Cross-checked in Phase 84 Theme J: a 90s blurred window against current main (B/C's gates in place) saw 0; the identical window against 543869af (the commit before ANY of Phase 84, so before B/C's gates existed) saw 3 `gh` spawns, and against c6a407fb (right after G/H, still before B/C) saw 2 — real, pre-gate forge polling with no visibility gate at all. That comparison is the number this budget exists to keep from regressing.
_hiddenBrowserTabRss: Phase 84 Theme J.1 — the owed F.5 number. A LEVEL: `memory-report.mjs --hidden-tabs=8` opens 8 real browser tabs over IPC (each a `--type=renderer` Chromium process, same group the main window's own renderer falls into) and reads the renderer-RSS delta divided by tab count. Reproducibly ~79.6-79.8 MB/tab across two separate runs (543869af and current main) — a real, not noise-level, per-tab-process floor for even an `about:blank` page (confirmed by `afterClose` returning within ~2 MB of the pre-open baseline both times, so it is held cost, not a leak). Identical before/after, as expected: this snapshot never leaves a tab hidden long enough to cross Theme F's 10-minute discard threshold, so it cannot see F's actual saving any more than `hiddenTerminalSessionRss` can see E's — recorded in outstanding.md alongside E.6's own gap. ×1.15 on the higher (after) reading rounds to the value below.

_measured.note: Re-measured 2026-09-06 (Phase 64 Theme G) via `node scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs` against this branch's packaged-equivalent build, after `moon run app:build desktop:bundle` — packaged-equivalent, on the phase author's machine (Darwin arm64). Theme G removed the seven now-unused `@codemirror/*` dependencies (code-editor.tsx's only importer switched to Monaco back in Theme C); entryKb/totalJsKb are measured identical bit-for-bit before and after that removal (1434.7 / 35405.7 both runs), because those packages had zero remaining source importers and were already excluded from the built output by tree-shaking — the win is dependency-tree hygiene (`pnpm install` reports -30 packages, and the packages don't resolve transitively via `@bilo-io/ui`/`@bilo-io/shell` either — `pnpm why @codemirror/view` returns nothing), not a bundle-byte reduction. The growth from the prior 1335.8/14098.3 baseline (2026-09-04) is accumulated drift from every phase merged since, most of it Monaco's own worker chunks (`ts.worker` alone is ~6.8 MB) landing in Themes A-C — not this theme's contribution. **Disclosure, not fixed here**: `totalJsKb` now exceeds its 15950 KB budget (35405.7 KB) — pre-existing as of this measurement, confirmed unrelated to the `@codemirror/*` removal (identical both sides of it), and out of Theme G's scope to rebaseline (this file's own header: never edit the budget number without the run that justifies it — that run is a Monaco worker-chunking pass, not this one). `bundle-budget.spec.ts` lives outside `moon run :test`'s gate, so this does not block CI. readyToShowMs/rendererInteractiveMs/diffScrollMedianGapMs are carried over unchanged from the 2026-09-04 run rather than re-measured — this theme touches only `package.json`/the lockfile, with nothing on the boot or scroll path to move.
